title: Prevent unrelated Required test completions from enqueueing writer-only workflow verification
root_cause: Repository Writer Operational Verification listens to all Required test completed events, although all of its jobs only admit verify/, verify-cheap/, verify-parity/ branches. Unrelated PR completions therefore trigger no-op workflow runs. Separately, four GitHub-provider orphaned queued runs from 7 Oct contain zero jobs and reject cancel with HTTP 409; their provider-side root cause is not proven.
impact: Avoidable webhook fan-out increases queued run counts, operational noise and user-visible delays. The four provider orphan runs require separate GitHub-side reconciliation.
failed_approaches: Repeatedly cancelling the four 7-Oct ghost runs: all HTTP 409
Treating an unmerged code change as already effective in main
fix: Add branch filters verify/**, verify-cheap/**, verify-parity/** at on.workflow_run while preserving job-level restrictions, original Required test and CodeQL, and PR-scoped concurrency.
prevention_rule: Never schedule writer-only follow-up workflows after non-writer Required test events; retain the canonical Required test and CodeQL gates. Distinguish actual queued jobs from ghost zero-job queued run records and deduplicate incidents by fingerprint; do not invent green outcomes.
outcome: CANDIDATE; merge requires protected Required test, CodeQL, exact-main source readback and new trigger evidence. Provider ghosts remain unresolved.
